title.jcr:title: i-Chips Scaler LSI (Large Scale Integration) Circuits

text_1.text: i-Chips Scaler LSI (Large-Scale Integration), revolutionizes electronic devices by integrating numerous electronic components and functions onto a single chip. This advanced technology enables significant miniaturization and improved performance. In the context of video processing, the term "scaler" refers to the integrated circuit's capability to perform scaling or resizing functions. Found in TVs, monitors, projectors, and video processors, i-Chips Scaler LSIs convert incoming video signals to different resolutions, ensuring compatibility with various display formats. By leveraging sophisticated algorithms and signal processing techniques, i-Chips Scaler LSI large scale integration circuits analyze and modify video signals, upscaling or downscaling them to match the desired resolution or aspect ratio of the display device. Additionally, these chips may undertake additional tasks like deinterlacing, color space conversion, and noise reduction. i-Chips Scaler LSIs help in achieving optimal picture quality and seamless compatibility across different video sources and displays. They empower users to enjoy diverse video formats and resolutions on devices with varying display capabilities, providing an immersive visual experience.

heading_2.jcr:title: Key Features of i-Chips Scaler LSI:

text_2.text:
• High-Quality Image Scaling: State-of-the-art algorithms that deliver superior image scaling capabilities, ensuring remarkable visual fidelity and accuracy
  • Flexible Resolution Support: With support for a wide range of input and output resolutions, integrates with diverse display systems and devices
  • Comprehensive Format Conversion: Equipped with advanced format conversion functionalities, handles conversions between various color spaces, pixel formats, and video standards
  • Image Enhancement and Correction: Edge-blending, color management, uniformity correction, and noise reduction, to optimize image quality and ensure stunning visuals
  • Flexible Image Manipulation: Including rotation, mirroring, flipping, warping, and overlay blending, enabling creative and dynamic visual presentations
  • Embedded CPU and Peripherals: Features an embedded CPU with cache and work RAM, allowing for efficient and flexible system integration. It also includes various peripherals such as Ethernet, USB2.0, and SD Card interfaces, expanding connectivity options
  • Powerful Control and Configuration: User-friendly interface to enabling precise customization and adjustment of image processing parameters
  • Reliable and Efficient Operation: Built with industry-leading reliability and efficiency in mind, i-Chips Scaler LSIs deliver exceptional performance while minimizing power consumption and heat generation.

text_3.text:
The versatile i-Chips Scaler LSI finds applications in various industries and domains, including:

 

  • Display Systems: Extensively used in high-resolution displays, monitors, televisions, digital signage, video walls, and projection systems to ensure optimal image quality and seamless scaling
  • Video Processing: Video processing systems, enabling format conversion, image enhancement, and manipulation in applications such as video broadcasting, video conferencing, surveillance, and professional video editing
  • Medical Imaging: Medical imaging devices, such as ultrasound machines, X-ray systems, and surgical displays, benefit from the advanced image scaling and manipulation capabilities while enabling precise and accurate visualization of medical data
  • Gaming and Multimedia: Immersive gaming industry and multimedia applications rely on i-Chips Scaler LSIs to deliver high-quality graphics, seamless image scaling, and dynamic visual effects, enhancing the overall gaming and multimedia experience.
  • Industrial Automation: Industrial automation systems, human-machine interfaces, and control panels to enable efficient visualization of data and enhance the user interface for improved usability and productivity

With their exceptional performance, advanced features, and diverse applications, i-Chips Scaler LSIs are the go-to solution for companies and industries seeking top-notch image scaling and manipulation capabilities. Experience the future of visual technology with i-Chips Scaler LSI products.

text_1.text: The Agilex® 3 FPGA is designed to deliver a blend of low power consumption, high performance, and small form factors, catering to various applications. This series stands out for its ease of use, making it an attractive option for designers familiar with Cyclone and MAX FPGAs. The Agilex 3 family includes B-Series and C-Series devices, each tailored for specific use cases. B-Series FPGAs are ideal for board-, platform-, and system-level management applications, such as power sequencing and system monitoring, whereas C-Series devices are designed to meet the broader and more demanding needs of industrial, medical, data center, and telecommunication applications. This range allows for versatile deployment in environments that require the latest in FPGA architecture, with a focus on AI capabilities in compact and power-efficient packages.

text_2.text: Altera Agilex 5 FPGAs offer enhanced performance and power efficiency, featuring industry-first AI Tensor Blocks, Arm Cortex-A76/A55 cores, and second-gen Hyperflex FPGA Architecture. They provide up to 2.5X performance and 50% lower power compared to Cyclone V FPGAs. With transceivers up to 28.1 Gbps, PCIe 4.0 x8, and DDR5 support, they cater to midrange FPGA applications in various markets like communication, video, industry, medical, data centers, and defense.

title.jcr:title: Ambarella Products: SoCs, CPUs, Chipsets, and More

text_1.text: Ambarella’s technologies make cameras smarter - enabling features like person detection, object classification, analytics, and more - performing complex data analysis in real time, delivering breathtaking imagery, and preserving vital system resources such as power and network bandwidth. Ambarella specializes in the development of deployable, scalable designs for intelligent cameras, offering a proven path to mass production. Check out our Ambarella products, SoCs, CPUs, chipsets, and more.

text_2.text:
What is Ambarella CVflow architecture?

CVflow is Ambarella’s computer vision chip architecture. Unlike a general-purpose CPU or GPU, it uses a dedicated vision processing engine programmed with a high-level algorithm description. That design scales performance to trillions of operations per second at very low power.

 

Which neural network frameworks do Ambarella SoCs support?

Customers map CNNs trained with industry-standard tools such as Caffe, TensorFlow, and PyTorch onto Ambarella processors. The CNN toolkit also covers ONNX. Detection, classification, and related CNN/DNN tasks run on-chip.

 

Which Ambarella SoCs are used for ADAS?

CV2FS is for front-facing stereovision ADAS cameras and computer-vision ECUs at L2+ and higher, with CVflow AI and ASIL C compliance. CV22FS targets forward-facing monocular ADAS cameras and similar ECUs, also with ASIL C. Ambarella uses ISO 26262 processes for functional safety–certified products used in ADAS and autonomous driving.

 

What makes Ambarella a low-power edge AI SoC choice?

The SoCs and CPUs are built for embedded edge platforms such as battery-powered cameras. They can outperform competing solutions on power efficiency, sometimes by 5× or more, while matching or beating results. Compression also cuts bandwidth and storage.

 

What does stereovision add for robotics?

Stereo processing turns a 2D view into a 3D scene and can detect generic obstacles the system was not trained to recognize. CV2 is positioned for accurate 3D environmental modeling, real-time neural network performance, advanced robotics, and industrial autonomous robots.

heading_1.jcr:title: Ambarella N1 Family - Edge GenAI Is Here

text_3.text:
Ambarella’s N1 family of Edge GenAI SoCs delivers the processing power needed to run multimodal large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and traditional CNN networks locally, without cloud dependency. Designed for autonomous mobile robots, on-premise AI boxes, smart city security, industrial automation, and intelligent healthcare, the N1 series sets a new benchmark for AI performance per watt at the edge.

 

As an authorized Ambarella distributor and value-added engineering partner, Macnica Americas provides component supply, design-in support, and technical consulting to help you bring your next N1-based design to production.

text_4.text:
CVflow® Chip Architecture

Ambarella CVflow® chip architecture is based on a deep understanding of core computer vision algorithms. Unlike general-purpose CPUs and GPUs, CVflow includes a dedicated vision processing engine programmed with a high-level algorithm description, allowing Ambarella architecture to scale performance to trillions of operations per second with extremely low power consumption.

 

With CVflow, customers can efficiently map their own CNN networks trained with industry-standard tools (e.g., Caffe, TensorFlow, PyTorch) to run on Ambarella processors.

text_5.text:
Stereovision

Stereo processing transforms the world from a flat 2D plane into a full 3D environment. This not only provides a richer, denser representation of the target scene, but also allows the detection of generic obstacles that the system hasn’t been trained to recognize, making navigation safer and more effective for warehouse robots, autonomous vehicles, and more.

text_6.text:
Low Power

Ambarella technology products are designed to be deployed in embedded platforms on the edge (e.g., battery-powered cameras), where power consumption is a critical concern. Ambarella SoCs and CPUs consistently outperform competitive solutions in power efficiency - sometimes by 5x or more - while delivering equal or superior results.

text_7.text:
Reduce Bandwidth & Storage Costs

Ambarella compression technologies dramatically reduce data transmission size, slashing storage costs and bandwidth usage with Ambarella products.

text_8.text:
Image Quality

One of the hallmarks of Ambarella processors is our image processing pipeline. Encompassing everything from HDR to EIS to dewarping, our state-of-the-art ISP ensures that every frame of every video is exquisite, improving safety and enhancing the viewing experience.

text_9.text:
Autonomy

From drones to robots, from taxis to long-haul semi trucks, Ambarella’s vision processors were designed to revolutionize the way we work and travel. Our hardware platforms deliver the flexibility required to implement all levels of automation, including partial, conditional, high, and full autonomy.

text_10.text:
Functional Safety

As an AI silicon company offering SoCs for applications such as ADAS and autonomous driving, Ambarella has implemented an array of internal processes and procedures to ensure that their functional safety-certified products comply with ISO 26262. These strict processes and procedures touch every aspect of the work Ambarella does - from technical documentation to software engineering to VLSI - and have become an inextricable part of Ambarella culture, from top to bottom.

text_1.text:
From embedded modules to high-density PCIe cards and complete systems, DEEPX delivers production AI inference where cloud and GPU solutions cannot operate. Exclusively available from Macnica.

 

The DEEPX product line spans from a 42mm M.2 module for drones and embedded devices to high-density PCIe inference cards for multi-channel surveillance servers. The DX-M and DX-H families are deployed today in security systems, smart factories, robotics platforms, and transportation infrastructure worldwide. All products share the same SDK and model framework support.

 

Macnica is the exclusive authorized distributor for North America, providing design-in support, evaluation hardware, and supply chain planning for production volumes, covering the full engagement from concept through volume ramp. Contact Macnica to request an evaluation kit or discuss your application with a field application engineer.

heading_1.jcr:title: DEEPX NPU Architecture Built Around Power, Thermal, and Precision

text_2.text: GPUs overheat in sealed enclosures, low-power NPUs cannot sustain production frame rates on real detection models, and cloud inference introduces round-trip latency and data egress that industrial and safety-critical systems cannot tolerate. DEEPX NPU architecture is designed specifically around these failure modes, with power envelope, thermal characteristics, and quantization fidelity treated as primary design constraints rather than secondary considerations. All performance claims are independently benchmarked against production workloads.

text_3.text: The DEEPX IQ8 quantization engine addresses the precision trade-off that limits most edge NPU deployments. Standard INT8 quantization reduces memory bandwidth and compute requirements but introduces accuracy degradation that requires per-layer calibration to recover. IQ8 performs INT8-width computation while preserving the numerical range of FP32 inference, delivering full-speed throughput without model accuracy loss and without manual calibration. For teams deploying YOLO-family or custom detection models, this removes a significant pre-production engineering step.

text_4.text: Thermal performance is validated in direct hardware comparison. Running identical workloads, the DX-M1 board surface measured 35.5 degrees C versus 60.7 degrees C for a competing chip. In sealed enclosures without active cooling, that 25-degree delta is the margin between a qualified fanless design and one that requires thermal redesign or derating at operating temperature.

heading_2.jcr:title: DEEPX Products: Chips, modules, PCIe cards, and Complete Systems

text_5.text: The DEEPX portfolio covers two distinct deployment scenarios. The DX-M Series are bare chips and M.2 modules for embedding directly into host systems: robots, cameras, vehicles, and edge devices. The DX-H Series are low-profile PCIe cards for servers and workstations running multi-channel video analytics and AI inference at scale. All products share the same DXNN SDK and support the same model frameworks.

text_1.text:
Embedded chip with external memory, industrial and automotive grades

 

The DX-M1 is the flagship embedded NPU. Its external memory architecture lets designers size LPDDR4x or LPDDR5 independently of the chip, supporting up to 8GB for workloads running multiple simultaneous models. Available as a bare chip or as an M.2 2280 module with 4GB LPDDR5 onboard. AEC-Q100 Grade 3 qualified, with Grade 2 available on request. This is the only DEEPX chip with automotive-grade certification.

 

Best for: Designs requiring memory flexibility, automotive-grade certification, or multi-model inference. Robotics platforms, industrial inspection systems, and smart city nodes.

heading_5.jcr:title: DXNN® SDK: One Toolchain for Every DEEPX Product

text_8.text:
The DXNN® SDK is the unified software stack for all DEEPX hardware. It provides a compiler that takes models from standard training frameworks and produces optimized binaries for DEEPX NPUs, applying IQ8 quantization automatically without manual per-layer tuning. The runtime supports concurrent multi-model execution and manages memory across chips.

 

The SDK supports x86 and ARM aarch-64 host architectures, runs on Windows and major Linux distributions, and is compatible with containerized deployments via Docker. Software partners including Edge Impulse, CVEDIA, NetworkOptix, Nota AI, and others have pre-integrated DEEPX hardware into their platforms using the DXNN SDK.

title.jcr:title: Altera® Cyclone® 10 FPGAs | Intel Cyclone 10 Solutions

text_1.text:
Altera Cyclone 10 is a family of field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) offering a low-power, cost-effective solution for various applications. The Cyclone 10 family includes two device families, Cyclone 10 LP, and Cyclone 10 GX, each optimized for different use cases.

 

The Cyclone 10 LP family is designed for low-power, cost-sensitive applications that require a balance of power and bandwidth. It features up to 220K logic elements, 6.4 Gbps transceivers, and 1,600 Mbps DDR3 memory support. It also offers integrated intellectual property (IP) such as ARM Cortex-M1 processor, analog-to-digital converter (ADC), and digital signal processing (DSP) blocks.

 

The Cyclone 10 GX family is optimized for high-performance applications that require higher bandwidth. It features up to 220K logic elements, 12.5 Gbps transceivers, and 2,666 Mbps DDR4 memory support. Altera Cyclone 10 also offers advanced processing capabilities with up to two ARM Cortex-A9 processors, hard floating-point DSP blocks, and a range of configurable I/O standards.

 

Overall, Altera Cyclone 10 FPGAs offer a versatile and flexible solution for various applications such as industrial automation, smart vision, and automotive. They provide low-power, cost-effective, and high-performance options that can be customized to meet specific requirements.
